name: check_opencode_sessions
description: Check OpenCode build sessions and progress via API. Lists recent OpenCode projects, shows session details, token usage, and build history. READ-ONLY - does not trigger new builds. Use this to see what OpenCode has built recently or check on build progress.

session_id.description: Optional: specific OpenCode session ID to get detailed info. If omitted, lists recent sessions.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return when listing (default: 5)
